name: Yaegashi Ayame
source:
An ordinary high school student who is dating her childhood friend. She's quite busy in preparation for her college entrance exams. 

Suddenly, she thought "how does sex with other men feel like?", and with that curiosity, she went and experienced sex with other men.

Has good grades, and is diligent.

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/extra/brand/008/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
